about: The magazine templates a Note can wear as a feature (e.feature.theme). Each one is an original, made-up magazine (assets/features/MAGAZINES.md): its look is css/feature.css .mag-<id>, its web fonts load from 'fonts' on its page (field/tools/publish.mjs), and the Studio's Magazine template panel offers it with these defaults and checks a Note for what it 'wants': building blocks (specs, stats, goodbad, verdict, box, callouts, steps, timeline, code), a Q&A (qa), a Spotted box (spotted), and at least 'pictures' photos or loops besides the cover. 'layouts': the photo-spread layouts that suit it, first the best (hero2, hero3, side, grid2, grid3, strip: field/tools/publish.mjs bookHtml). Every template also wants its cover text, a cover picture, the card summary, subheads and a pull quote.
